glosses: обладающий выдающимися способностями, незаурядным умом и талантом, в высшей степени одарённый

examples.text: Ваш мальчик гениален!
Он был гениальным композитором.
Гениальная симфония.
This fellow is ingenious; he fixed a problem I didn’t even know I had.

glosses: Characterized by genius; cleverly contrived or done.

examples.text: That is an ingenious model of the atom.
Many ingenious lovely things are gone / That seemed sheer miracle to the multitude, / protected from the circle of the moon / That pitches common things about.
He sent me an ingenious reply to an email.
I have scarcely recovered the surprise of the ingenious question, before I meet another surprise in the still more ingenious answer

glosses: Someone possessing extraordinary intelligence or skill; especially somebody who has demonstrated this by a creative or original work in science, music, art, etc.

examples.text: She's a genius; she won a Nobel Prize at fifteen!
Marx stand höher, sah weiter, überblickte mehr und rascher als wir andern alle. Marx war ein Genie, wir andern höchstens Talente.

Excuse, therefore, the shortcomings of genius under the sudorific influence of the summer solstice; for be assured that the vertical sun, however it may dulcify and mature cherries, plums, and other fruitful ‘plumpitudes,’ is by no means favorable to the development of intellectual products.

In the old days, to my commonplace and unobserving mind, he gave no evidences of genius whatsoever. He never read me any of his manuscripts, […], and therefore my lack of detection of his promise may in some degree be pardoned.

glosses: Inspiration, a mental leap, an extraordinary creative process.

examples.text: a work of genius
to add a dash of cinnamon amid such umami was pure genius

glosses: The tutelary deity or spirit of a place or person.

examples.text: and the genius of the place: the growing enthusiasm for codified standards in the Army and Navy

glosses: Ingenious, brilliant, very clever, or original.

examples.text: What a genius idea!

examples.text:
